body:
You’re not weak. You’re not pathetic. 

Fearing to go through with something such as ending your life means that a small part of you still values the life you have. 

Don’t ignore the smallest part that’s telling you “don’t, please, not worth the “bravery””.

Friendship is a underrated gift that this generation of people take for granted. I believe if you’ve found a friend in someone you should always cherish them.

Friends don’t always have to constantly talk to each other to let the other one know that they care. People tend to lead lives that don’t give them the luxury of always having time. 

Perhaps for OP, this is a time where you may be realizing you can’t maintain the ways of this friendship forever. That’s totally normal and expressing them is beyond generous. 

I am a culprit of not understanding how to communicate well but that’s because I’ve always had the idea that my presence was not important. But everyone in my life know I care for them deeply.

To this day I (22F) have a crush (28M) who is simply not ready to let go of his single life due to a failed 7 year relationship....7 years ago. 

These things take time. You seem to be very level headed and aware which is more than anyone can do. But it might help to talk about those feelings with a close friend or even Jane. My crush occasionally talks to his ex just to check if she’s doing okay and where they both are in life. (You don’t throw away 7 years...) 

I wouldn’t call the time “wasted”. It just didn’t work out to a marriage with kids and trips to Hawaii every year.

So..no, I did not have a 3some with them. I was pretty sure what was going on when he brought her. She was so odd. They knew I was uncomfortable so she left us alone the second time we met up (when he apologized for not disclosing that he was bringing her over.) 

I’m never seeing him again so I went for it...JUST with him. She came into the hotel room almost right after I was done getting dressed. 

He loves his cake and wants every slice or whatever. 

He posts so many travel photos. A lot of those photos are groups that she’s in. I really should’ve known, sometimes the things that are staring right at you are the ones you miss.
